perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Lilly's Q2 2026 revenue rose 48% to $23.0 billion, driven primarily by Mounjaro and Zepbound volume, while full-year revenue guidance increased to $85-$87 billion.

Retatrutide completed the clinical data package supporting planned global obesity-related submissions, with a U.S. BLA planned for Q1 2027; Lilly also committed another $4.5 billion to Indiana manufacturing expansion.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Execution is visible in current commercial volume growth, regulatory progress for oral GLP-1 Foundayo/orforglipron, late-stage retatrutide results and continued manufacturing investment.
Q2 volume grew 60% but realized prices fell 13%, making price/mix pressure a material counter-signal to exceptional demand growth.

risks: Realized-price declines can offset volume growth and intensify as access broadens.
Retatrutide remains investigational pending regulatory submissions and approvals.
Large manufacturing commitments and acquisition activity raise execution and capital-allocation demands.
contradictions: Very strong volume/revenue momentum coexists with meaningful realized-price compression; both must be preserved rather than collapsing the signal into a one-direction growth narrative.
unknowns: Long-run net pricing after payer/government changes is uncertain.
Retatrutide approval timing and eventual commercial uptake remain unknown.
